page: Amazon Web Services c9g.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores and 192 vCPUs based on the 64-bit ARM architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of threads to physical cores, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from simultaneous multithreading.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local instance storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. For network connectivity, the server delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers and low-latency communication.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture and high core density of the Graviton processor family offer a favorable performance-per-watt and resource-density profile compared to traditional x86 architectures. This bare-metal configuration is designed for highly parallel, compute-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include high-performance computing, batch processing, distributed analytics, video encoding, and large-scale containerized microservices that benefit from dedicated physical cores and high network throughput.
